name: repro-plan-monorepo
description: REPRO PLAN - Fortune 500 Grade SRHR Platform (Railway + Vercel Deployment)

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
scripts.clean: cd backend && npm run clean 2>/dev/null || true && cd ../frontend && rm -rf build 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.test: cd backend && npm test 2>/dev/null || true && cd ../frontend && npm test -- --watchAll=false 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.deploy: echo 'Run: npm run deploy:backend && npm run deploy:frontend'

author: REPRO PLAN Team
